features.text: Speed Queen® TR7 Matte Black Agitator Top Load Washer - TR7006BN
Speed Queen® DR7 Matte Black Front Load Electric Dryer - DR7004BE
Pets are family. Our special pet cycles, including pet hair removal, ensure their items and yours get the best care possible.
Goodbye, wrinkles. So long static. Steam boost turns your dryer into much more than a tool for removing moisture from loads.
The anti-static feature will help keep you from that all-too-common embarrassing moment.
You want install flexibility? The dryer’s reversible door helps you streamline your laundry room setup.
Over-drying your favorite clothes and linens wears them out faster. With our Over-Dry Protection Technology and Commercial Cool-Down Technology, we’ll take good care of that favorite outfit.
